title: The Stain on the Borrowed Apron
youtube_title: The Stain on the Borrowed Apron | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Telling the truth early makes a small mistake easier to mend.
summary: At a ceramic studio sill above the quiet plaza, Yuri is tangled up with a berry stain on a borrowed apron and almost hides it. Yuri tells Grandpa Sol the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
